clue.text: Minister's cut always included

indicators.note: included means the word for always is placed inside the word for cut

parts.note: to rend is to cut or tear apart
ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'

explanation.surface: A government minister's budget cut has always been part of the plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister's' reads as possessive, but the 's is just 'is' linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverend is a clergyman, and a church minister is one such member of the clergy.

clue.text: Lacklustre meat cooked for fellow resident

parts.note: flat means dull or lacklustre

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of meat are prepared into another form

explanation.surface: A dull bit of meat cooked for someone who shares the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A flatmate is someone sharing a rented home with you, so a fellow resident of the flat.

clue.text: In time, hesitation can be fun

indicators.note: In means the hesitation sound is placed inside the unit of time

parts.note: an hour is a period of time
um is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Pausing now and then in conversation can make it amusing.
explanation.definitionFit: Humour is comic quality or amusement, so it is a synonym of fun.

clue.text: Philistine's tyres blown? That's hard to explain

parts.note: Philistine is the setter, so the setter's is my

indicators.note: blown tyres are wrecked, so the letters of tyres are scrambled

explanation.surface: The setter's tyres have burst, and nobody can say why.
explanation.walkthrough: Philistine is the setter's pseudonym, so 'Philistine's' gives MY, as the setter would say it.
explanation.definitionFit: A mystery is something puzzling that cannot readily be accounted for.

clue.text: Ramshackle antiquity appearing in adverts regularly

indicators.note: appearing in means the antique is placed within the letters taken from adverts
regularly means taking every other letter of adverts

parts.note: a relic is an object surviving from antiquity

explanation.surface: A tumbledown old piece keeps turning up in advertisements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' here takes the even letters, starting from the second, not the odd ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Derelict describes a building fallen into ruin, which is ramshackle.

clue.text: Big and bright benevolent heart at first

indicators.note: at first means the heart of benevolent comes before the word for bright
heart means the central letters of benevolent

parts.note: the two middle letters of this ten-letter word
luminous means bright, giving off light

explanation.surface: A large, shining, kind-hearted person, as a character sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: Voluminous means occupying much space, a synonym of big, often of clothing.

clue.text: Korean-inspired meals can have it for starters

definitions.text: Korean-inspired meals can have it for starters

indicators.note: for starters means the opening letter of each word, starters being first courses

explanation.surface: Korean-style dinners may include it as an appetiser.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the dish and also spells it from its initial letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Kimchi is spicy fermented cabbage, the national side dish of Korea, often served before or with meals.

clue.text: Every now and then Joe has awful feelings of resentment towards a rival

definitions.text: feelings of resentment towards a rival

indicators.note: Every now and then means taking alternate letters of the words that follow

parts.note: alternate letters J, E, A
lousy means awful, very poor

explanation.surface: Joe occasionally gets a bad case of resenting his rival.
explanation.definitionFit: Jealousy is envious resentment of a rival, especially in love.

clue.text: Sexy kiss for Romeo's fancy

indicators.note: kiss for Romeo means the letter for kiss replaces the letter for Romeo

parts.note: erotic means sexy
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet; the 's is 'is', linking to the definition
X is the conventional symbol for a kiss

explanation.surface: A sexy kiss is what Romeo has in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: EROTIC fits 'Sexy' tempting solvers to enter it; swapping its R for X fixes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Exotic as an adjective means unusual and elaborate, a near-synonym of fancy.

clue.text: Top banana?

parts.note: top banana is slang for the leading person; read literally it is the finest fruit on the bunch

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase for the finest of a group is taken literally as a banana at its finest.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means the finest of a group, and a banana grows in a bunch, so the top banana is literally that.

clue.text: See 10
Swordsman who works at the end of the garden?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one who fences with a sword

definitions.text: who works at the end of the garden?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, playful: someone who puts up the fence that marks the garden's boundary

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading coins a sense from fence: a person who builds fences.
explanation.definitionFit: A fencer competes in the sport of swordplay, and jokingly is a builder of garden boundaries.

clue.text: Coming together, some work as nuns

indicators.note: as is read loosely as 'like nuns', placing the unit inside the place nuns live

parts.note: nuns live in a convent
an erg is a unit, some amount, of work in physics

explanation.surface: Uniting, some people do their work as nuns do.
explanation.walkthrough: ERG is a small physics unit of work; it is placed in CONVENT, where nuns are. CONVERGING is a tempting near-miss; the crossings rule it out.
explanation.definitionFit: Convergent means tending to meet at a point, or coming together.

clue.text: Perhaps cold egg in Irish stew

indicators.note: in means the egg is placed inside the stewed letters
Irish stew is a dish, but here stew means the letters of Irish are mixed up

parts.note: a nit is the egg of a louse

explanation.surface: Maybe a chilled egg sits in a pot of Irish stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Irish stew' looks like the dish, but 'stew' is the anagram signal; 'Perhaps' marks a cold as one example of the condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhinitis is inflammation of the nose's lining, and a common cold is one example of it.

clue.text: In essence, God, Buddha and Jesu use idiosyncrasy

indicators.note: In essence means the central letters of each word, their essence or heart

explanation.surface: At root, three religious figures all draw on eccentricity.
explanation.walkthrough: The middles are O, DD, N, ES and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Oddness is strangeness or peculiarity, close to an idiosyncrasy or quirk.

clue.text: Broadcaster's drawback covered up

indicators.note: covered means the broadcaster's name wraps around the other piece

parts.note: Sky is a British satellite broadcaster, so Sky's
draw back: the word draw read backwards

explanation.surface: A TV company's flaw has been hushed up.
explanation.walkthrough: Sky is a UK pay-TV broadcaster. 'drawback' looks like a flaw; split it as draw back, DRAW reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Skywards means towards the sky, which is upwards.

clue.text: A prize being wasted

definitions.note: the noun names the state of being wasted

parts.note: a trophy is a prize such as a cup

explanation.surface: An award is being thrown away.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrophy is the wasting away of a body part, the condition of a muscle shrinking.

clue.text: Champion welcomes a boycott of hot stuff

indicators.note: welcomes means the hero takes in the other pieces

parts.note: a hero is a champion
a ban is a boycott or prohibition

explanation.surface: A champion accepts a boycott of something spicy.
explanation.definitionFit: A habanero is a very hot chilli pepper, so it is fiery stuff.

clue.text: Picture a reason for a sensitive person to delay drinking tea?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a police photograph of a face

definitions.text: a reason for a sensitive person to delay drinking tea?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: the cup's too hot to hold

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as MUG'S HOT to get the reason someone sensitive would wait.
explanation.definitionFit: A mugshot is a police photo of a suspect's face, a kind of portrait.

clue.text: Solvers surrounded by rats in flipping sanctuary? Don't ask!

indicators.note: in means the rats go inside the turned-round sanctuary
flipping means the word for sanctuary is turned backwards

parts.note: a den is a private retreat or sanctuary

indicators.note: surrounded by means the solvers are placed inside the rats

parts.note: rats are vermin
the setter addresses solvers as you

explanation.surface: Solvers caught among rats in a hideout? Better not to ask.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter addresses the solvers directly, so they are 'you'; there are two containers, one nested inside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a curt refusal to explain, telling someone it is none of their business.

clue.text: Leave secured by you, once up for union

indicators.note: secured by means the word for leave is held inside the old form of you
up in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of you
to quit is to leave

explanation.surface: A departure agreed by people of old, in favour of the union.
explanation.walkthrough: Equity is the British actors' trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Equity is the name of the UK trade union for actors and performers.

clue.text: Relish being in Glasgow as a bisexual

indicators.note: in means the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Enjoying life in Glasgow as a bisexual person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relish' looks like a verb about enjoyment; it is the condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Wasabi is a pungent green Japanese condiment, a kind of relish served with sushi.

clue.text: That woman is following her organisation's desires

indicators.note: following means the words for that woman is come after her organisation

parts.note: the WI, the Women's Institute, is a British organisation for women; the 's links to the rest
she's is the contraction of she is

explanation.surface: She follows her group's wishes, as a loyal member.
explanation.walkthrough: The WI, Women's Institute, is a long-running British community organisation for women.
explanation.definitionFit: Wishes as a plural noun are things one longs for, synonyms of desires.

clue.text: Accessories for Caroline and Peggy Sue?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: dark glasses worn as a fashion accessory
second meaning, read as two words: girls who are the subjects of songs

explanation.walkthrough: Sweet Caroline and Peggy Sue are pop songs named after girls, so these are SUNG LASSES.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunglasses are tinted spectacles worn as fashion items, which count as accessories.

See 2
Made up for United having dismal start

parts.note: at one means united or in agreement

indicators.note: start means the first letter of dismal

explanation.surface: Compensated for a football side's poor opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' looks like a football club name; it is AT ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone is to make amends, so atoned is the past tense meaning compensated.

clue.text: Approach clear river

parts.note: overt means open and clear
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: The way towards an unobstructed river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a river in North Yorkshire, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: An overture is an opening approach or proposal made to someone.
